comparison.objective: Stop a spinning centrifuge, wait, open it, remove a sample tube, and rack the tube; the candidate services a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe-state recognition, button and lid operation, and tube extraction/insertion versus precision two-tool rotary manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires rotor stopped before opening and an upright tube in the rack; candidate requires locked angular calibration and repeatable actuation.
comparison.reason: No meaningful physical-skill or success-condition overlap exists.
